# Boiler service

The gas boiler gets a yearly check before the heating goes on in October.

## Pressure

The gauge should read between 1 and 1.5 bar when the system is cold. If it drops below 1, open the filling loop under the boiler until the needle is back in range, then close both valves.

## Service log

2022: the engineer cleaned the condensate trap, replaced the ignition electrode and tested the flue gas. Combustion readings were within the manufacturer's range and the expansion vessel held its charge.

2023: annual check only. The flue terminal was clear, the casing seals were intact and the carbon monoxide alarm in the hallway passed its test. The engineer suggested bleeding the upstairs radiators before winter.

2024: the diverter valve was sticking, so hot water ran lukewarm while the heating was on. The part was replaced under warranty, logged as claim 7Q4K-29XP, and the engineer flushed the system with inhibitor afterwards.
